_comment: Path regexes. A changed file must match at least one rule or `fleet tier` refuses: there is no default tier. `critical` and `wire` are the hand-signed list of paths where a wrong verdict reaches a spindle; edit them with the operator, never alone.

1: targeted tests for the changed files (~5s)
2: a contract test on the changed wire
one live run with a named observable (fleet ready -> operator -> fleet receipt)
3: a NEGATIVE live run: induce the failure and observe the fail-closed screen
